# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.
# Regenerate: npx tsx scripts/snapshot-commodity-rules.ts

### context: full
SHEET METAL COST INPUT RULES:
  thicknessMm=2.4 (use OCCT min wall thickness)
  blankLengthMm=336 (largest bbox × 1.05)
  blankWidthMm=252 (second-largest × 1.05)
  dieCostGBP=92300 (OCCT — use verbatim)
  dieLife: progressive→1000000; single-stage→300000; laser+brake→999999
  numOps: 2 for simple bracket, 3–5 for formed, 6–8 for complex progressive

### context: degraded
SHEET METAL COST INPUT RULES:
  thicknessMm=1.5 (use OCCT min wall thickness)
  blankLengthMm=? (largest bbox × 1.05)
  blankWidthMm=? (second-largest × 1.05)
  dieCostGBP=progressive→80000/single→15000/laser+brake→3000 (OCCT — use verbatim)
